correctness.rationale: The all-degrees, nine-generator CE differential and signed V4 chain actions were constructed in full and checked exactly by the embedded executable. Differential ranks are (0,5,14,31,46,31,14,5,0); each nonidentity involution is verified to square to identity and commute with the differential; ranks of images on the two eigenspaces give all homology traces. Separate invariant orbit-sum cochains independently recover every rational quotient Betti number. The algebraic finite quotient theorem and Nomizu equivariance imply the stated topology. The proof does not infer from a sample of a larger family.

value.rationale: The diamond is the smallest simple graph with two distinct triangles sharing an edge, a natural non-star, non-path chordal example. Its two graph involutions act differently in graded cohomology, and their geometric quotients have H2 dimensions 9 and 10 and top-degree dimensions 1 and 0 respectively, which cannot be determined from ordinary Betti numbers. The full exact V4 decomposition gives a useful baseline for graph-symmetry quotient topology; finite scope and absent cup products are expressly bounded.
